title: Restricted-component runtime bounds
statement: Let an input consist of a positive dimension $n$, positive integers $a,d$ with $2a\le d$, and an integer Fourier bound $B\ge1$. Put $\varepsilon=a/d$ and $R=(n+1)(B+1)/\varepsilon$. The restricted-weight construction work, the stage query budget, and the restricted local work are each at most $2^{148}R^{88}$ when viewed as real numbers.
hypotheses_covered: Positive accuracy numerator and denominator encoding
Twice the accuracy numerator is at most its denominator
Fourier bound is at least one
